Operations & network transformation

Change the network only after you know where the problem sits.

Operator-led support for multi-site, branch and distribution networks under service, margin, capacity or accountability pressure.

Separate structural problems from imported ones

A site can look expensive because of its lease and catchment, because central routing sends it the wrong work, or because local leadership has failed. The same score can lead to three different decisions.

What the work tests

  • End-to-end cost and service across the full route to customer.
  • Whether work is allocated to the right site, hub or team.
  • Capacity, accountability and management routines.
  • The operating model required to hold the change after implementation.

Read the network restructuring case study

Possible outputs

  • Site and route economics
  • Target operating model
  • Transition priorities
  • Governance and ownership
  • First-phase leadership support
